verdict.rationale: Sessions persist conversation history to disk and can be resumed with full prior context (docs-7, docs-16, docs-24), and SessionStore lets you mirror transcripts to external backends for cross-host resumption (docs-29). However this is session/thread-level persistence rather than true cross-session long-term memory (e.g. semantic memory, facts recalled across unrelated threads); CLAUDE.md/rules provide some persistent instructions but not dynamic memory. missing for 10: dedicated long-term/semantic memory store distinct from raw transcript replay, cross-thread memory retrieval mechanism, independent verification of persistence working reliably in production.
